A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] '''navigator''' served with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], especially as a [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] on [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebel]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]].
